newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan to auction six-month maturity bonds.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan to auction six-month maturity bonds.

text.p: The State (central) Bank of Pakistan said on Thursday it had invited bids up to Monday for the auction of six-month maturity short-term federal bonds.
The result of the auction will be announced on Tuesday with settlement set for Wednesday, it said.
It said a pre-auction target had been set at 4.089 billion rupees but bids could be rejected without giving reasons.
In the last auction on September 17, bids worth 50 million rupees were accepted at a weighted average yield of 13.4995 percent per annum against a target of 4.158 billion rupees.
